title: Building Ecology
text: Select Ecology and insert one microcore to draw uniformly from its matching biomes. Lay flat ground or liquid around the lower third, add suitable decorations and a central treasure orb, then enclose it in single-layer Spiritual Crystal. The real biome is unchanged.

Earth: temperate vanilla Overworld biomes, Deep Dark, Lush Caves and Dripstone Caves. Water: oceans and cold biomes. Fire: hot biomes and Nether biomes except Soul Sand Valley. Air: End biomes and Mirror Dream Border.

Light: the light layer and Void Starsea. Dark: the dark layer and Reversion Mire. Time and Space: their remaining biomes. Omni: registered biomes, including other mods. All microcores exclude Spacetime Mirror Corridor.

Landscapes are built from biome blocks, liquids and suitable decorations rather than copied buildings or inventories. Treasure uses the related biome/dimension loot table. Pure Solidified Spacetime is replaced with Excited Rough Spatial Crystal in these landscapes.
Every original block inside the sphere, including unbreakable blocks, is cleared before construction. The following cutaway exposes the interior; the actual shell is closed.
